stage_blockers: 5 completed forward sessions below the 60-session review floor
1 matured forecast below the 30-forecast review floor
New paper run needs frozen dates, eligible runtime, session-aware controls and reconciliation verification
execution_conditions: Daily completed-bar research remains distinct from executable quotes and broker-paper fills
Reserve pending buys and modeled costs before admission; buys must meet the 20% turnover ceiling
Matched simulated Individual, Monarchy and market control series use identical capital, clocks, costs and opportunity sets
Zero-interest cash is an explicit baseline assumption, not an available Treasury yield
Halts persist across restarts and cash flows; no automatic reset or forced liquidation at an invented price
Reductions remain subject to cash, position, price, freshness and turnover controls
An optional Monarchy-only broker adapter needs separately qualified free quotes, Trading quota, opaque durable order IDs, ambiguous-submit reconciliation and cancellation recovery
Exact dates and finite data/work budgets must be preregistered before any future run; none are activated by this decision

responsibilities.operator: Owner initiates a reviewed finite run; an authorized agent checks entry conditions and receipts
responsibilities.kill_switch: Owner retains stop authority; implementation must durably halt new risk and reconcile any pending submissions
responsibilities.reconciliation: Running agent compares orders, partial fills, cash, holdings and corporate actions after each session; unexplained differences halt and go to owner
responsibilities.incident_recovery: Owner resolves ambiguous account state; agent preserves spent budgets and never activates a second quota owner
responsibilities.backup: Owner controls private storage and attended FIDO recovery; update and verify observation-inclusive backups before relying on recovery
responsibilities.halt_reset: Owner records review and an explicit restart decision; never reset through a deposit or a new run ID
